name: Pipeliners - SEO Case Study Jun-Sep 2026
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-24

# Summary
An 8-page client-facing case study prepared by TAG Marketing in September 2026: "How We Grew Google Visibility for a Phoenix-Area Trenchless Sewer Company by 47% in 3 Months". June 2026 is the baseline and September the 3-month milestone. June and September are compared on the same 21 days because September was not finished.

# Key findings
- Headline: ranking keywords up 47% (345 to 507, Search Atlas US). Google impressions up 4.1% (13,983 to 14,555, GSC). Organic engagement rate up 13.9% (48.5% to 55.2%, GA4). #1 in Phoenix for "florence pipe break repair" (Rank Tracker).
- Clicks held steady (31 to 32), organic visits 99 to 96, Site Health 909 to 911, organic leads 0 in both periods (stated plainly, no lead increase claimed).
- The challenge: organic was about 7% of visits, no leads came from organic, average position 44, and technical debt (hidden OTTO keyword blocks, city copy hidden on mobile, thin city pages).
- Work listed with go-live dates: hidden words cut from 20,648 to 481 (Sep 12), city copy made visible on mobile on all 37 pages (Aug 28), plugin FAQs moved into real on-page FAQs on 4 pages (Aug 27), 36 unstyled headings fixed (Sep 2), dead sitemaps removed (Sep 15), 5xx errors 8 to 0, title and meta audit 37 of 37 clean (Aug 31), Tempe, Buckeye and Florence rewrites, focus keyword alignment on 9 pages (Sep 16 to 17), "here!" links replaced.
- New organic landing pages: /gilbert and four blog posts got organic visits for the first time.

# Decisions and status
- Next measurements: full-month September pull (Oct 3) and city-page reviews on Oct 9 and Oct 22.
- Built with `build_case_study.py` (ReportLab), not summarized.
